key: A private group's build on JoshuuDev's victory-amd fork of VIctory, verified by PortWatch. It runs GTA VI with ray-traced lighting at about 3-5 fps, almost never crashes, and gets as far into the story as the leading public builds. The in-game phone renders really well, and the map menu runs at a higher frame rate. It's built mostly for AMD and also works on NVIDIA, at a lower frame rate. Code not public.

key: DexNom Runtime, a fork of VIctory for AMD Radeon, tested on a Radeon RX 7900 XTX. It builds on ZSlayerHQ's victory-world-runtime with its own fixes for shaders, texture streaming and GPU memory. PortWatch has seen it running with ray-traced lighting working, the first AMD build on our board to get it: the open world looks close to the retail game, and it plays through missions at about 3-4 fps (about 1 fps with ray tracing on), rarely crashing.
